title: MATLAB code for 'Moving Without Making Progress: Shorter Forward Runs Explain the Loss of Net Advance in a Model of Swedish Mutant Amyloid Precursor Protein Transport'

creators.name: Kuznetsov, Andrey V
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, North Carolina State University, Raleigh, NC 27695-7910, USA

description:
MATLAB implementation of a five-state stochastic model of bidirectional axonal cargo transport and of its continuum advection-reaction counterpart, applied to wild-type and Swedish mutant amyloid precursor protein (APP), Rab5 endosomes and lysosomes in human neurons.

The package contains the trajectory simulator with the observation model that reproduces the published selection of tracks and frames, the fitting routines, the fitted parameter sets, the steady-state spatial model with turnover, the fluorescence model with a soma-derived tagged product, the analysis scripts with their saved outputs, the scripts that write Figs. 1-5 of the paper, and a README documenting every file. One master script, run_short_all, reproduces the figures and the quoted numbers from the saved fits.

The trajectory statistics and fluorescence profiles are digitized from the published figures of Feole et al. (2024, J Biol Chem 300, 107137) and its Supporting Information; the digitized values are included, the figure panels are not.

Base MATLAB only, no toolboxes; developed and run on R2026a.
